summary: The first owner-dispatched G2 canary (2026-11-12) executed nothing:  - Live ListItemsOfAShip items carry no @Type/@ItemType, so minerals and gas   were never observed and baseline-v1 refused every cost-bearing action.   ClientSnapshotProvider takes an optional resource_item_designs mapping   (item_resource_kinds of client.itemDesigns from listAllDesigns4); an item   without its own type is the resource its design's @ItemType names. The   factory passes it only where designs are read, so the baseline path is   unchanged. Ambiguous or unmapped items stay None. - baseline-v1 plans collect_all_resources only after a room upgrade, so the   canary kept nothing and rejected collect_daily_reward with a misleading   reason. In canary mode, when no safe-to-retry request remains, the policy   did not plan the collection itself and the gate allows it, AuthorizedPolicy   plans one collect_all_resources (preconditions checked); --plan-only's   canary_choice mirrors it. Not-safe requests are now rejected with   "canary: not safe to retry". Full mode is unchanged. - The run record hard-coded game_version.server as null. The factory records   server_game_version per account at login; the record reports it per account   and at the top level when every logged-in account agrees. Built by a subagent in an isolated worktree; an independent verifier subagent requested changes (a fallback collection when minerals and gas are both unobserved; a design-conflict gap), both fixed with regression tests by the parent agent, who also updated README.template then README.md.
